questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Crossing time=width/normal speed=(10) s। current drift=4·(10)=4×(10); resultant speed দিয়ে crossing time নয়।

questions.question_bn: Crossed fields E=27 V/m,B=3T। undeflected particle speed কত m/s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Opposite electric/magnetic forces cancel qE=qvB⇒v=E/B=(9)। charge ও mass cancel।

questions.question_bn: Sound v=340 m/s। source 20 m/s ও listener 10 m/s পরস্পরের দিকে আসে; emitted f=352 Hz। heard f কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Approach দুদিকে: f′=f(v+vo)/(v−vs)=32×(11)·350/320=35×(11)। numerator ও denominator signs ভিন্ন।

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Equivalent power 1/F=1/f₁+1/f₂−d/(f₁f₂)=2/(11)−1/(11)=1/(11)। separatedlenscontactsumincorrect।

questions.question_bn: Food sample 2 kg-এ preservative 13mg। mass-based concentration কত ppm?

questions.question_bn: Fe₂O₃+3CO→2Fe+3CO₂। Fe₂O₃amount 19 mol complete conversion। CO₂mol কত?

questions.question_bn: Diluted water initial DO8mg/L, after 5days 6mg/L; sample fraction 1/14, blank correction 0। BOD₅ কত mg/L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। DO depletion=2mg/L in diluted mixture। Original sample BOD=(DOinitial−DOfinal)/fraction=2nmg/L।

questions.question_bn: Hard water-এ synthetic sulfonate detergent soap-এর চেয়ে কার্যকর কেন?
questions.explanation: Soap carboxylates insoluble Ca/Mg scum দেয়। suitable synthetic sulfonates comparatively soluble salts রাখে, cleansing action বজায় থাকে।

questions.question_bn: Ideal gas P2atm,V=172.20000000000002L,T300 K,R0.082। amount কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। (14)=PV/(RT)=2·12.3×(14)/(0.082·300)=24.6×(14)/24.6=(14) mol; no extra Avogadro multiplication।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 29×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 29। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (29)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((29)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: Al³⁺+3e⁻→Al; charge 12F,100%efficiency,MAl27। aluminium কত g?

questions.question_bn: 1400g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=4, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=24×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((24)×10⁻²)=(1/(24))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: 1100 mL0.20MNaOH; MNaOH 40g/mol। solutemass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Volume 0.1nL,moles 0.20·0.1×(11)=0.02×(11)। massmoles×40=0.8ng; mL→Lconversion দরকার।

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂⇌2NH₃ equilibrium-এ compression, T fixed। shift কোনদিকে?

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=21M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?

questions.question_bn: Sample 11 mol diene (2C=C per molecule), complete Br₂ addition। Br₂ mole required কত?

questions.question_bn: Rate=k[A]²[B]। [A] 8 গুণ,[B] half হলে rate ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Rate factor=((8))²×(½)=(8)²/2। coefficient/stoichiometry দিয়ে order replace করা যাবে না।
